description: A Python script implementing a command class 'RebaselineCL' for fetching new baselines from try jobs for a code change (CL). It manages test result fetching, determining tests to rebaseline, and triggering try jobs, primarily used in Chromium's testing infrastructure.

classes.name: RebaselineCL
classes.description: A command class to fetch new baselines from try jobs for the current CL, managing test result analysis and try job triggering.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the RebaselineCL command with specific options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that performs the rebaseline process, including fetching results, determining tests to rebaseline, and triggering try jobs.

methods.name: _get_issue_number
methods.description: Retrieves the current CL issue number.

methods.name: git_cl
methods.description: Returns a GitCL instance for interacting with the Git repository.

methods.name: trigger_builds
methods.description: Triggers try jobs for specified builders.

methods.name: builders_with_no_results
methods.description: Returns builders that have no completed results.

methods.name: builders_with_pending_builds
methods.description: Returns builders with pending (not finished) builds.

methods.name: _try_bots
methods.description: Returns list of try bot builder names.

methods.name: _fetch_results
methods.description: Fetches test results for a list of builds.

methods.name: _test_prefix_list
methods.description: Determines which tests need to be rebaselined based on results and changed files.

methods.name: _tests_to_rebaseline
methods.description: Identifies tests to rebaseline for a specific build based on test results.

methods.name: _fetch_tests_with_new_failures
methods.description: Lists tests with new failures from a retry summary JSON.

methods.name: _log_test_prefix_list
methods.description: Logs the list of tests scheduled for rebaselining.

methods.name: rebaseline
methods.description: Initiates the rebaselining process for identified tests.
